decisions.decision: Version data used for each forecast
decisions.context: Reproducing a forecast for any past week requires retaining the data version used to build it (d:11).

alternatives.label: Data version repository
pros: Reproducibility: dedicated data versioning
cons: Small team: adds a tool to maintain

alternatives.label: Data versioning in code repository
pros: Small team: keeps workflow near code
cons: Reproducibility: data handling details unspecified

alternatives.label: No data versioning
cons: Reproducibility: cannot reliably recreate past inputs

decisions.rationale: Reproducibility decides the choice: retain explicit data versions so past-week inputs can be recovered, accepting the maintenance cost of a dedicated tool.
consequences: Record the data version associated with each forecast run.
Maintain the versioned data store and its retention policy.

decisions.decision: Process weekly data in batches or streams?
decisions.context: The system processes weekly demand, and the brief specifies a weekly production run without a real-time requirement (d:15).

alternatives.label: Batch-based data processing
pros: Weekly run: aligns processing to the forecast cadence
Small team: simpler scheduled workflow
cons: Weekly run: results wait for the batch window

alternatives.label: Real-time, stream-based data processing
pros: Weekly run: can process arriving data continuously
cons: Small team: adds streaming operations
Reproducibility: requires tracking event-time inputs

decisions.rationale: The weekly run decides the choice: batch processing fits the stated cadence and keeps the pipeline manageable, at the cost of not processing demand data continuously.
consequences: Schedule data preparation around the weekly forecast run.
Capture the batch inputs and cutoff used for each run.

decisions.decision: How should model building and training run?
decisions.context: New model ideas should reach production quickly while protecting the weekly run; the design space covers automated model building (d:18) and batch training (d:19).

alternatives.label: Model building pipeline with batch-based learning
pros: Fast iteration: automate training, evaluation, and validation
Weekly run reliability: train offline in repeatable batches
cons: Small team: pipeline needs setup and ownership

alternatives.label: Model builder component with incremental learning
pros: Fast iteration: isolated builder supports model changes
cons: Weekly run reliability: incremental updates add production state
Small team: component integration needs ownership

alternatives.label: Model building in development tool with batch-based learning
pros: Small team: familiar development workflow
cons: Fast iteration: manual promotion can slow release
Weekly run reliability: less automated validation

chosen.label: Model building pipeline with batch-based learning

decisions.rationale: Weekly run reliability decides the choice: automate offline training and validation before promotion, accepting the initial pipeline setup to make model iteration repeatable.
consequences: Keep experiments and production training reproducible from versioned inputs.
Gate promotion on evaluation and validation results.

decisions.context: The system produces weekly forecasts, with no stated request for interactive or real-time predictions (d:5).

alternatives.label: Precompute serving
pros: Weekly run: forecasts are ready as reports
Small team: avoids a live prediction service
cons: Fast iteration: changes appear at the next forecast run

alternatives.label: Data batch based model serving
pros: Weekly run: writes scheduled predictions to storage
cons: Small team: requires serving-job and storage operations

alternatives.label: Microservice based model serving
pros: Fast iteration: serves predictions as needed
cons: Small team: adds live service operations
Weekly run: real-time capability is not required

decisions.rationale: The weekly run decides the choice: precomputed forecasts match the requested delivery cadence and reduce operational work, giving up immediate availability for model changes.
consequences: Publish a forecast artifact for each weekly run.
Associate each artifact with its model and data versions.

decisions.decision: How should changes reach production safely?
decisions.context: The team wants new model ideas in production quickly without disrupting the weekly run, so automated delivery and rollback matter (d:8, d:10).

alternatives.label: CI/CD pipeline with rollback to previous model version
pros: Fast iteration: automates delivery
Weekly run reliability: supports restoring a prior model
cons: Small team: requires pipeline and rollback procedures

alternatives.label: Build and Deployment scripts with single model in production
pros: Small team: few deployment components
cons: Fast iteration: manual execution slows changes
Weekly run reliability: recovery is less explicit

alternatives.label: CI/CD pipeline with N versions in production
pros: Fast iteration: supports parallel model versions
cons: Small team: multiple production versions add operating work

chosen.label: CI/CD pipeline with rollback to previous model version

decisions.rationale: Weekly run reliability decides the choice: automate delivery while retaining a known recovery path, accepting the effort to establish and maintain CI/CD and rollback procedures.
consequences: Make model promotion and rollback repeatable pipeline steps.
Keep the prior production model available for recovery.

decisions.context: New model ideas must not break the weekly run; the design space offers tests for components, training, model quality, pipelines, and APIs (d:26).

alternatives.label: Unit testing pipeline components
pros: Fast iteration: catches component defects early
cons: Weekly run reliability: does not validate the full workflow

alternatives.label: Integration testing pipeline components
pros: Weekly run reliability: checks connected pipeline behavior
cons: Fast iteration: broader tests can take longer

alternatives.label: Testing trained model quality
pros: Weekly run reliability: checks forecast quality before release
cons: Small team: requires defining quality thresholds

alternatives.label: No testing
cons: Weekly run reliability: defects can reach production

decisions.rationale: Weekly run reliability decides the choice: validate that pipeline components work together before release, accepting some added test time; the design space permits combining this with component and model-quality tests.
consequences: Run integration checks before production promotion.
Define forecast-quality acceptance thresholds as a separate project requirement.

uncovered: Prioritized brief requirements: reproducibility of any past week; weekly run reliability; fast production iteration; small-team maintainability.
How long to retain historical data, models, and forecast artifacts, and how to reproduce a past run end to end.
Forecast accuracy metrics and release thresholds for model-quality tests.
The brief does not specify forecast consumers, delivery format, or access controls.
Operational monitoring, alerting, and ownership for failed or delayed weekly runs.
